scientific_evidence_role: read-only API and deployment feasibility evidence only; no adapter lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible

official_api_boundary.retain: Hindsight.retain and retain_batch synchronously store memory content with timestamp, context, document_id, metadata, entities, tags, and official fact extraction.
official_api_boundary.recall: Hindsight.recall returns ranked RecallResult rows with stable id, text, type, provenance fields, and RecallScores.final plus semantic, keyword, and reranker diagnostics.
official_api_boundary.snapshot: Hindsight.list_memories exposes paginated memory units and total count, allowing complete snapshots without database queries.
official_api_boundary.reflect: Hindsight.reflect generates an answer and is excluded from the common WMA scoring path.
official_api_boundary.bank: create_bank exposes the official toggles for observations, text search, temporal retrieval, graph retrieval, and reranking. Defaults must remain enabled unless a frozen compatibility issue requires a separately named control.

deployment_boundary.selected_candidate: hindsight-all embedded Python server with project-local pg0 storage
deployment_boundary.reason: The official package supports Linux embedded PostgreSQL/pgvector-compatible storage without a separately managed shared database, enabling a fresh per-run state root and restart test.
deployment_boundary.not_yet_authorized: No package installation, pg0 binary acquisition, database start, model download, model load, API call, or port allocation is authorized by this audit.
deployment_boundary.shared_service_isolation: Any future embedded service must use a fresh project-owned data root and a preflight-selected loopback port, and must stop before terminal acceptance.

proposed_wma_mapping.reset: Start one isolated embedded Hindsight server on a fresh pg0 root, create one fresh bank, and record exact version/config health before ingest.
proposed_wma_mapping.ingest_turn: Buffer ordered normalized turns; append attachment captions with image_id and source provenance. No image byte is encoded.
proposed_wma_mapping.end_session: Call retain_batch synchronously once per completed WMA session with one item per user/assistant pair, original timestamp and metadata, and document_id equal to session_id.
proposed_wma_mapping.snapshot_memories: Page through list_memories until total is exhausted; normalize every returned unit and stable backend id.
proposed_wma_mapping.retrieve: Call recall with official budget=mid, max_tokens=4096, trace=true, and all default retrieval arms; truncate only the returned ordered list to frozen WMA top_k and preserve RecallScores.final.
proposed_wma_mapping.export_memory_delta: Diff complete list_memories snapshots by backend id without reading PostgreSQL internals.
proposed_wma_mapping.reload_from_disk: Stop the embedded server cleanly, restart it against the same project-owned pg0 root, reconnect the client, and verify bank, snapshot, and retrieval identities.
proposed_wma_mapping.final_answer: Never call reflect. The common frozen WMA answer generator consumes normalized recall results.

fairness_and_claim_boundaries.llm_substitution: For same-protocol WMA reproduction, retain/consolidation must use the shared frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct endpoint rather than the official gpt-4o-mini default; this is a disclosed matched-backbone evaluation substitution, not the paper's reported setup.
fairness_and_claim_boundaries.embedding_and_reranker: Preserve the official local BGE embedding and cross-encoder reranker families at immutable model revisions unless a separately frozen ablation tests shared embeddings.
fairness_and_claim_boundaries.multimodality: Hindsight is evaluated as caption-mediated text memory only. It cannot receive a native multimodal-memory label or image-path retrieval credit.
fairness_and_claim_boundaries.retry_semantics: Official internal LLM and embedding retries are method semantics and must be counted separately from prohibited lifecycle or WMA unit reruns.
fairness_and_claim_boundaries.official_scores: ACL paper scores remain source-reported context and cannot populate the same-protocol local WMA table.

decision: ACCEPT Hindsight for separate execution-source, model, environment, embedded-service, adapter, and lifecycle prefreezes.
next_allowed_gate: Freeze the minimal Git-tracked execution-source subset and exact default embedding/reranker model revisions. Do not install or run the service until Wave-1 releases the shared model stack.
prohibited_actions: calling reflect in the WMA scoring path
querying PostgreSQL internals to fabricate a snapshot when list_memories is available
disabling official retrieval arms or observations without a separately frozen control
claiming native multimodal memory from caption-mediated ingestion
conflating internal provider retries with unit reruns
starting dependencies, pg0, models, ports, lifecycle, or numerical evaluation from this audit
populating a numerical comparison-table cell from this audit
